title: 失踪的女孩

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    沐如霖在沐如岚屋子里跟沐如岚学习到十点半的时候，就被沐如岚赶回去睡觉了，她揉着他的发，告诉他小孩子要早睡早起才能身体好，姐姐都给你补课了，还怕成绩过不了么？
沐如霖抱住书离开沐如岚的房间，两点多的时候起来喝水，却看到姐姐的房间灯亮着，他悄悄推开一道房门，看到姐姐正拿着纸笔翻着书本认真的学习着，顿时心里一片心疼，眼角不知不觉就湿了。
这已经不是第一次了，每一次看到沐如岚纤细的背影微微的弯着认真看书做题目到三更半夜的时候，他便觉得很心疼，别人口中的天才，在他眼中只是让人心疼的姐姐，她每一步都是脚踏实地辛苦的换来的，那些人凭什么一次一次的，以她会不会被谁赶超做打赌？！
那些讨人厌的王八蛋！
噗嗤……
可爱的弟弟又哭了吗？
背着门，对着窗，沐如岚低着头无声的轻笑，笑容依旧是温暖动人，她桌上是已经做好的十张她自己从网上下的这几年高考的考试卷，她轻轻的打了个哈欠，唔……学习是件很累人的事，所以她前世只是得过且过，却不料今生竟然做到了这一步，果然这人一变态，还真就什么都干的出来了。
她收拾桌面，一张纸飘落在地上，噢，白色的画纸上，是一个素描的人偶设计稿呢。
沐如岚和沐如森沐如霖一起到了学校，发现校门口竟然停了警车，不少学生表情有些惶恐，沐如岚一问，才知道原来又出事了，继两年前的几起失踪案之后，又有人失踪了，还是他们鎏斯兰学院的人！
“好像是金家二小姐，金茉莉！”学生会干部李清抱着书包道。
沐如岚眉头微蹙的点了点头，“什么时候的事？”
“听说是今天早上报的案，前天晚上金茉莉就没有回家，不过那女孩很爱玩，经常不回家，所以她家人也没在意，是后面她姐姐给她打电话找不到人，又问了她朋友，都没有人知道她在哪里，这才发现不对头，这不今早儿就报警了。”李清一边说着，一边伸手想要帮沐如岚拿书包，只是还没碰到了，沐如森便小兽般凶狠的瞪了他一眼，把沐如岚手里的书包抱进了怀里。
沐如岚看了沐如森一眼，看了眼校门口的警车，眼眸微微的眯了眯，不经意的侧头，看到沐如霖似乎有些失神的样子，“怎么了？”
沐如霖被吓到了似的，额头竟然冒出了一片冷汗，双手冰冷，他看到沐如岚担忧的神色，表情有些僵硬的点点头，“我没事。”
“那快回班吧，明天以前班级都必须布置好。”沐如岚说着带着人走进校门。
沐如霖跟着迈着步子走了进去，却忍不住回头看向那警车，眼里带了几分惊恐。
金茉莉……
停在门口的一辆黑色跑车上，墨谦人一身白色衬衫黑西裤，气质清清冷冷，乌黑碎碎的刘海下，那双冷漠却又仿佛能够洞悉一切的眼眸追着沐如岚的身影渐渐远去。
他腿上放着一份资料，有一张相片附于其上，阳光从微微下滑的车窗外滑进，落在上面反射出灼眼的白光，那上面少女干净温暖的笑若隐若现。
坐在驾驶座上的陆子孟微微侧头，“现在什么感觉？”

墨谦人收回目光，把车窗关起，垂眸看着腿上的相片和资料，“很可疑。”
“靠！你倒是说说人家怎么可疑了？”陆子孟忍不住提高了点声音，搞不懂自家这哥儿们怎么会觉得沐如岚这样完美优秀的学生可疑，可是偏偏他又说不出到底哪里让他觉得可疑了。
“感觉。”墨谦人淡淡的道，显得苍白的脸上，冷漠的眼眸倒映着相片上的笑脸，“一个人完美成这样是不正常的。”
陆子孟翻了个白眼，“完美不正常，难不成是变态么？”
“有可能。”墨谦人冷冷的道，“我在她身上，闻到了犯罪的味道……”
陆子孟翻了个白眼，他懒得跟他说，“你要回警局还是去我那儿？我妈说今晚给你接风洗尘呢。”
“我还有事，晚上再去你那。你走吧。”墨谦人扬起脑袋阖上眼帘，他的睫毛很黑很长，皮肤却苍白的厉害，然而整个人却风华隽秀，就这么交叠着双腿靠在车后座，也显得极其的赏心悦目。
陆子孟怔了下，忽的想到什么，“你说什么？”
“走。”
“诶……这是我的车啊！”哪有这么光明正大的赶人霸车的啊！想他今天大清早的从温柔乡里爬起来去接机，免费当了几个小时司机不说，竟然还要可怜兮兮的打车回去？

Mu Rulin studied with Mu Rulan in Mu Rulan's room until half past ten, when Mu Rulan rushed him back to sleep. She rubbed his hair and told him that children must go to bed early and get up early to be healthy. Your sister has already given you extra classes, are you still worried that your grades will not pass?
Mu Rulin hugged the book and left Mu Rulan's room. He got up to drink water at around two o'clock, but saw that the light in his sister's room was on. He quietly opened a door and saw his sister flipping through the book with pen and paper and studying seriously. He suddenly felt distressed and the corners of his eyes became wet unconsciously.
This was not the first time. Every time he saw Mu Rulan's slender back slightly bent over reading a book and doing questions at midnight, he felt very distressed. The genius in others' eyes was just a distressed sister in his eyes. Every step she took was earned through down-to-earth hard work. Why did those people make bets on whether she would be overtaken by someone again and again? !
Those annoying bastards!
Pfft...
Is my lovely brother crying again?
With her back to the door and facing the window, Mu Rulan lowered her head and chuckled silently, her smile still warm and moving. On her desk were ten prepared college entrance examination papers that she had downloaded from the Internet in recent years. She yawned softly, well... studying is a very tiring thing, so she just muddle along in her previous life, but unexpectedly she has achieved this step in this life. As expected, this person can really do anything once he is perverted.
She cleared the table and a piece of paper fell to the ground. Oh, on the white drawing paper, there was a sketch of a doll design.
Mu Rulan, Mu Rusen and Mu Rulin arrived at the school together and found that a police car was parked at the school gate. Many students looked a little scared. When Mu Rulan asked, she realized that something had happened again. After several disappearances two years ago, another person was missing, and it was someone from their Luosilan Academy!
"It seems to be the second young lady of the Jin family, Jin Moli!" Li Qing, a student union cadre, said while holding his schoolbag.
Mu Rulan frowned and nodded, "When did it happen?"
"I heard that the case was reported this morning. Jin Moli didn't come home the night before yesterday. However, the girl loved to play and often didn't come home, so her family didn't pay attention. Later her sister called her and couldn't find anyone. She also asked her friends, but no one knew she was there. "Somewhere, I realized something was wrong. Didn't I call the police this morning?" Li Qing said as he reached out to help Mu Rulan get her schoolbag, but before he touched it, Mu Rusen glared at him fiercely like a little animal and took the schoolbag in Mu Rulan's hand into her arms.
Mu Rulan glanced at Mu Rusen and then at the police car at the school gate. She narrowed her eyes slightly and turned her head inadvertently. She saw that Mu Rulin seemed to be a little distracted, "What's wrong?"
Mu Rulin seemed to be frightened. Cold sweat broke out on his forehead and his hands were cold. Seeing Mu Rulan's worried look, he nodded stiffly, "I'm fine."
"Then go back to class quickly. Classes must be arranged before tomorrow." Mu Rulan said and led people into the school gate.
Mu Rulin followed suit and walked in, but couldn't help but look back at the police car with a bit of horror in her eyes.
Golden Jasmine…
In a black sports car parked at the door, Mo Qianren was wearing a white shirt and black trousers. He had a cool and cold temperament. Under the black and broken bangs, those cold but seemingly insightful eyes gradually followed Mu Rulan's figure away.
There was a document on his lap, and there was a photo attached to it. The sun slid in through the slightly lowered car window, and reflected a dazzling white light on it. The girl's clean and warm smile on it was faintly visible.
Lu Zimeng, who was sitting in the driver's seat, turned his head slightly and asked, "How do you feel now?"
Mo Qianren withdrew his gaze, closed the car window, and looked down at the photos and information on his lap, "It's very sad.suspect. "
"Depend on! Could you please tell me why he is suspicious? "Lu Zimeng couldn't help but raise his voice. He didn't understand how his brothers could find such a perfect and outstanding student like Mu Rulan suspicious, but he couldn't tell what made him suspicious.
"Feeling. "Mo Qianren said calmly, his pale face and cold eyes reflecting the smiling face in the photo, "It's not normal for a person to be so perfect. "
Lu Zimeng rolled his eyes, "Perfection is not normal, could it be that he is a pervert? "
"It's possible. "Mo Qianren said coldly, "I smell the smell of crime on her..."
Lu Zimeng rolled his eyes, not bothering to tell him, "Do you want to go back to the police station or to my place? My mother said she would take care of you tonight. "
"I have something else to do, so I'll go to your place in the evening. You go. "Mo Qianren raised his head and closed his eyes. His eyelashes were very dark and long, and his skin was very pale. However, his whole body was elegant and graceful. Just leaning on the back seat of the car with his legs folded, it looked extremely pleasing to the eye.
Lu Zimeng was stunned for a moment, and suddenly thought of something, "What did you say? "
"Walk. "
"Hey...this is my car! "How can there be such an upright person who drives people and dominates cars? I don't think he got up from Rourou Township early this morning to pick up the airport. Not only did he work as a driver for free for a few hours, but he actually had to take a pitiful taxi back?
